messages.en: I had a weird dream last night, like I was lost at my old school.
Were you looking at photos of our school before bed?

collocations.en: be interested in taking a course

messages.en: Are you interested in taking a photography class here?
Definitely! I've wanted to learn how to take photos for ages.

senses.en_definition: To originate from or have as a starting point.
At first; first of all; for the first time (archaic).

collocations.en: hear the story for the first time (archaic)

senses.en_definition: Original or former; the beginning or original state (archaic).
An opening expression introducing a story or episode, equivalent to “Now” or “To begin with” (classical).

messages.en: Has the game started yet? I'm only just about to head out.
Not yet. It's been delayed a bit because of the rain earlier. Just come over. I'll wait for you at the entrance.
Can you breathe normally again now?
Yeah, I'm breathing normally now. Just a bit tired after climbing those stairs earlier.
